reminders.text: Verify with a tool before claiming this is done.
Read the local implementation and tests before editing.
Do not revert user changes or unrelated dirty worktree state.
Do not claim revenue unless Stripe or billing evidence proves it.
Configured checks are inventory; recorded blocks and warnings are usage evidence.
Verify the paid landing page and checkout route before sending traffic.
Run the smallest relevant test set for this change.
Name the workflow owner, repeated failure, proof artifact, and stop condition.
